name: manual_067531
claim: A test stand-in that replaces a production primitive must be labelled as a stand-in where it is defined; when that primitive is externally defined and authoritative producer vectors exist for it (a signature scheme, digest, codec or wire format), a second test must prove the real primitive against those vectors

decisions.notes: 2026-10-22 review of PR 422: supersedes lesson_327192b4d88a; the vector requirement applies only where an authoritative producer vector exists for an externally defined primitive, not to every stand-in and not only to signatures

rationale: 2026-10-22 review of PR 422: supersedes lesson_327192b4d88a; the vector requirement applies only where an authoritative producer vector exists for an externally defined primitive, not to every stand-in and not only to signatures
